title: Peach Cobbler
description: Juicy cinnamon peaches baked under a buttery, golden batter topping that rises up around the fruit. Serve warm with ice cream.

image.alt: A baking dish of peach cobbler with golden biscuit topping

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 350F oven}. Put the butter in the baking dish and set it in the oven until melted, {time 5 min}.
Toss the peaches with the sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the milk and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the batter evenly over the melted butter; don’t stir. Spoon the peaches and their juice over the batter; don’t stir again.
Bake until the topping is puffed and golden and the fruit bubbles at the edges, {time 40-45 min}. Cool for {time 15 min} before serving.

notes: The batter rises up through the fruit as it bakes; that’s what makes the cobbler’s crisp edges and soft middle.
